description: Step-by-step compliance/identification wizard (KYC/AML style, domain neutral): subject identity (person or company), identification documents, addresses, ownership structure tree (company subjects), declarations and a final review with submission. Per-step validation is pluggable through IKycStepValidator (use KycStepFluentValidator from Tempo.Blazor.FluentValidation); drafts persist and submit through IKycProvider. Errors render as a localized summary plus inline field messages.

parameters.name: Provider
parameters.description: Persistence backend for drafts and the final submission. Required.

parameters.name: StepValidator
parameters.description: Per-step validator gating Next/Submit. When null, navigation is not gated. Use e.g. KycStepFluentValidator from Tempo.Blazor.FluentValidation.

parameters.name: DraftId
parameters.description: Identifier of an existing draft to resume. Null starts a new draft.

parameters.name: InitialSubjectKind
parameters.description: Subject kind preselected for new drafts. The company path adds the ownership structure step.

parameters.name: OnSubmitted
parameters.description: Callback invoked after a successful submission.

parameters.name: OnDraftSaved
parameters.description: Callback invoked after the draft was saved, with a snapshot of the draft.

parameters.name: OnStepChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the active step changes.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.
